choose.when: and status not in ('PENDING_CONFIRM','CLOSED','REJECTED','CANCELLED') and sla_paused_at is null and < now()

where.if: and (title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
select it_ticket.*, (select count(*) from it_missing_report m where m.requester_id=it_ticket.creator_id and m.status='PENDING') as pending_report_count from it_ticket
order by case status when 'NEW' then 0 when 'ACCEPTED' then 1 when 'IN_PROGRESS' then 2 when 'PENDING_CONFIRM' then 3 else 4 end, case when due_at is null then 1 else 0 end, due_at asc, created_at desc, id desc limit #{offset}, #{size}

select current_ticket.no, count(ahead.id) as queue_ahead from it_ticket current_ticket left join it_ticket ahead on ahead.assignee_id = current_ticket.assignee_id and ahead.status in ('ACCEPTED','IN_PROGRESS','PENDING_USER','PENDING_VENDOR') and ( coalesce(ahead.assigned_at,ahead.accepted_at,ahead.created_at) < coalesce(current_ticket.assigned_at,current_ticket.accepted_at,current_ticket.created_at) or (coalesce(ahead.assigned_at,ahead.accepted_at,ahead.created_at) = coalesce(current_ticket.assigned_at,current_ticket.accepted_at,current_ticket.created_at) and ahead.id < current_ticket.id) ) where current_ticket.assignee_id is not null and current_ticket.status in ('ACCEPTED','IN_PROGRESS','PENDING_USER','PENDING_VENDOR') and current_ticket.no in #{no} group by current_ticket.id,current_ticket.no
select * from it_ticket where order by coalesce(sla_reminded_at, due_at), id limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: (case when accepted_at is null and response_due_at is not null and (due_at is null or response_due_at < due_at) then response_due_at else due_at end)
status = 'PENDING_CONFIRM' and finished_at <= #{before} and (confirmation_reminded_at is null or confirmation_reminded_at <= #{before})
mapper.select: select * from it_ticket where order by coalesce(confirmation_reminded_at, finished_at), id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update it_ticket set sla_reminded_at=#{now}, updated_at=updated_at where no=#{no} and
update it_ticket set confirmation_reminded_at=#{now}, updated_at=updated_at where no=#{no} and
mapper.select: select count(*) as `total`, coalesce(sum(case when status not in ('CLOSED','REJECTED','CANCELLED') then 1 else 0 end),0) as `openCount`, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'CLOSED' then 1 else 0 end),0) as `closedCount`, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'NEW' then 1 else 0 end),0) as `pendingAccept`, coalesce(sum(case when status in ('ACCEPTED','IN_PROGRESS','PENDING_USER','PENDING_VENDOR') then 1 else 0 end),0) as `processing`, coalesce(sum(case when status not in ('PENDING_CONFIRM','CLOSED','REJECTED','CANCELLED') and sla_paused_at is null and < now() then 1 else 0 end),0) as `overdueCount`, coalesce(round(avg(case when rating > 0 then rating end), 2),0) as `avgRating`, coalesce(sum(case when rating > 0 then 1 else 0 end),0) as `ratedCount`, coalesce(round(avg(case when finished_at is not null and (source is null or source != '紧急处理补报') then coalesce(resolve_work_minutes,timestampdiff(minute, created_at, finished_at)) end), 0),0) as `avgMinutes`, coalesce(round(avg(case when accepted_at is not null then coalesce(response_work_minutes,timestampdiff(minute,created_at,accepted_at)) end),0),0) as `avgResponseMinutes`, count(accepted_at) as `responseCount`, coalesce(sum(case when accepted_at is not null and response_due_at is not null and accepted_at <= response_due_at then 1 else 0 end),0) as `responseSlaOk`, coalesce(sum(case when accepted_at is not null and response_due_at is not null then 1 else 0 end),0) as `responseSlaTotal`, coalesce(sum(case when finished_at is not null and due_at is not null and finished_at <= due_at then 1 else 0 end),0) as `slaOk`, coalesce(sum(case when finished_at is not null and due_at is not null then 1 else 0 end),0) as `slaTotal`, coalesce(sum(case when tried_kb = 1 then 1 else 0 end),0) as `triedKbCount` from it_ticket
select cast(created_at as date) as `day`, count(*) as `count` from it_ticket where created_at >= #{since} group by cast(created_at as date) order by min(created_at)
select cat1 as `name`, count(*) as `value` from it_ticket where created_at >= #{since} group by cat1 order by `value` desc

select assignee_name as `name`, count(*) as `total`, coalesce(round(avg(case when rating > 0 then rating end), 2), 0) as `rating`, coalesce(round(avg(case when finished_at is not null and (source is null or source != '紧急处理补报') then coalesce(resolve_work_minutes,timestampdiff(minute, created_at, finished_at)) end), 0), 0) as `avgMinutes`, coalesce(round(avg(case when accepted_at is not null then coalesce(response_work_minutes,timestampdiff(minute,created_at,accepted_at)) end),0),0) as `avgResponseMinutes`, count(accepted_at) as `responseCount`, count(finished_at) as `resolvedCount` from it_ticket where assignee_name is not null and assignee_name <> '' and created_at >= #{since} group by assignee_name order by total desc limit 10
select asset_no as `no`, count(*) as `times` from it_ticket where asset_no is not null and asset_no <> '' group by asset_no order by times desc limit #{limit}
